faq.q: How long does the code last?
faq.a: Full Suu Premium for one month. When the month ends the subscription renews automatically at the regular price — if you don't want to be charged, cancel it in your App Store (or Google Play) settings before it expires; you still keep the remaining days.
Unlimited AI analysis, food recognition and calories from a photo, advanced macro stats, adaptive reminders and an ad-free experience.
The batch is limited. To reach as many people as possible we give one code per person — the same email and the same connection can't claim twice.

faq.q: The code didn't arrive — what now?
faq.a: Check your spam folder first. Submit the form again with the same address and we'll re-send it.
Yes. App Store codes for iPhone, Google Play codes for Android — just pick your phone in the form.

footerNote: Codes are single-use and limited to available stock.
